description: Search all of the user's mail, of any age: plain words, a name, an address, or Gmail's operators (from:, to:, cc:, subject:, has:attachment, filename:, is:unread, is:starred, label:, in:, before:, after:, older_than:, newer_than:, "quoted words", -word, OR, parentheses). The mail on this Mac first, and Gmail itself where that isn't the whole answer (few found, or reaching back past what this Mac keeps), so mail years old is found too, said so on its line. Answers threads, newest first, with their ids. For when you know its words, its sender or its date; mail_recall finds mail by what it is about.
name: mail_search
title: Search Mail
